def.description: Alternate clicks focusing on vertical movement.

A small target with a larger hit box than the visuals.

Allows you to focus on a small precise target while being more
forgiving with scoring
VertArc but with "camera up" rotated so that the Arc is coming from the left wall out to the right.
VertArc but with "camera up" rotated so that the Arc is coming from the left wall out to the right.
AF Strafe Shifty but with the camera rotated so that the strafing is vertical.
AF Strafe Teleport but with the camera rotated so that the strafing is vertical.
